fullPassage: Art Nouveau, literally meaning “new art,” is a style of art that emerged as a means to depart from Historicism, which relied heavily on copying or reinterpreting works from past artistic movements. In an effort to revive craftsmanship and establish a genuinely modern aesthetic that would reflect the changing times, Art Nouveau artists and designers placed emphasis on innovation, experimentation, and originality in their creations. They drew much of their inspiration from natural objects: flowers, plants, insects, and other organic forms. This focus on nature was reflected in the asymmetrical lines, curvilinear shapes, and intricate patterns that all became the hallmarks of the Art Nouveau style. Aspiring to “total works of the arts,” the practitioners of Art Nouveau used these elements to create a sense of harmony in their work. This is apparent in the works of Antoni Gaudí such as Park Güell, the design of which is perfectly integrated into the landscape, with columns seemingly sprouting from their natural surroundings.

det.korean: past=과거의 / future=미래의 / previous=이전의 / ancient=고대의 / former=이전의
det.analysis:
① future: 미래의 — past(과거의)의 반의어 ←정답

② previous: 이전의 — past와 같은 방향(지난)이라 반의어가 아니에요

③ ancient: 고대의 — 오히려 더 먼 과거라 past와 같은 축이에요

④ former: 이전의 — 지난 것을 뜻해 past와 비슷해요
det.tip: past artistic movements = 과거의 예술 운동 ↔ future(미래의).

questions.passage:
(A) The museum proudly displays the <u>works</u> of several famous painters.

(B) This old clock still <u>works</u> perfectly after a hundred years.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 works의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: works: (A) 작품 (B) 작동하다
det.analysis:
① (A) 작동하다 (B) 작품: (A)는 화가들의 '작품'이라 반대로 짝지어졌어요

② (A) 작품 (B) 작동하다: 미술관이 화가들의 '작품(works)'을 전시하고 + 낡은 시계가 여전히 '작동한다(works)' ←정답

③ (A) 작품 (B) 노력: (B)는 시계가 '작동한다'는 뜻이에요

④ (A) 직장 (B) 작동하다: (A)는 화가들의 '작품'이에요
det.tip: works: 화가의 '작품' vs 기계가 '작동하다'.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a set of ideas or principles about beauty and what is artistically pleasing"

det.korean: athletic=운동의 / synthetic=합성의 / aesthetic=미적 감각, 미학 / ascetic=금욕적인
det.analysis:
① athletic: 운동의 — 아름다움과 무관해요

② synthetic: 합성의 — 인공 재료를 뜻해 정의와 안 맞아요

③ aesthetic: 미적 감각 — 아름다움과 예술적 즐거움에 관한 원칙이라 정의와 일치해요 ←정답

④ ascetic: 금욕적인 — 절제하는 삶을 뜻해 무관해요
det.tip: beauty ~ artistically pleasing → 미적 감각(aesthetic).

questions.passage: They drew much of their inspiration from natural objects: flowers, plants, insects, and other organic forms. This focus on nature was __________ (reflect) in the asymmetrical lines, curvilinear shapes, and intricate patterns that all became the hallmarks of the Art Nouveau style.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: reflect → reflected: 'was ~ in'은 수동태라 과거분사(p.p.)로 바꿔요.
det.analysis:
'This focus on nature was __________ in ~'은 'be동사(was) + ______'로 수동태예요. 자연에 대한 집중이 선·무늬로 '반영된' 것이니 reflect를 과거분사 reflected로 바꿔요.

→ 따라서 reflect를 reflected로 써요.
det.tip: was reflected in = ~에 반영되었다 (수동).

questions.passage: Aspiring to “total works of the arts,” the practitioners of Art Nouveau used these elements to create a sense of harmony in their work. This is apparent in the works of Antoni Gaudí such as Park Güell, the design of which is perfectly __________ (integrate) into the landscape, with columns seemingly sprouting from their natural surroundings.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: integrate → integrated: 'is ~ into'는 수동태라 과거분사(p.p.)로 바꿔요.
det.analysis:
'the design of which is perfectly __________ into the landscape'는 'be동사(is) + ______'로 수동태예요. 설계가 자연 경관에 '통합된' 것이니 integrate를 과거분사 integrated로 바꿔요.

→ 따라서 integrate를 integrated로 써요.
det.tip: is integrated into = ~에 통합되어 있다 (수동).

questions.passage: Art Nouveau, literally meaning “new art,” is a style of art that emerged as a means to depart from Historicism, which relied heavily on copying or reinterpreting works from past artistic movements. In an effort to revive craftsmanship and establish a genuinely modern aesthetic that would reflect the changing times, Art Nouveau artists and designers placed emphasis on innovation, experimentation, and originality in their creations. They drew much of their inspiration from natural objects: flowers, plants, insects, and other organic forms. This focus on nature was reflected in the asymmetrical lines, curvilinear shapes, and intricate patterns that all became the hallmarks of the Art Nouveau style. Aspiring to “total works of the arts,” the practitioners of Art Nouveau used these elements to create a sense of harmony in their work. This is apparent in the works of Antoni Gaudí __________ Park Güell, the design of which is perfectly integrated into the landscape, with columns seemingly sprouting from their natural surroundings.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: such as=~와 같은(예시) / instead of=~ 대신에 / rather than=~보다는 / because of=~ 때문에
det.analysis:
빈칸 뒤 'Park Güell'은 가우디 작품의 한 '예시'예요.

① such as: 가우디의 작품, 예를 들어 Park Güell처럼 — 예시를 드는 연결사 ←정답

② instead of: ~ 대신에 — 대체 의미라 안 맞아요

③ rather than: ~보다는 — 비교/선택이라 안 맞아요

④ because of: ~ 때문에 — 인과라 안 맞아요
det.tip: the works of Gaudí ______ Park Güell → 예시 such as.

questions.passage: Art Nouveau, literally meaning “new art,” is a style of art that emerged as a means to __________ Historicism, which relied heavily on copying or reinterpreting works from past artistic movements. In an effort to revive craftsmanship and establish a genuinely modern aesthetic that would reflect the changing times, Art Nouveau artists and designers placed emphasis on innovation, experimentation, and originality in their creations. They drew much of their inspiration from natural objects: flowers, plants, insects, and other organic forms. This focus on nature was reflected in the asymmetrical lines, curvilinear shapes, and intricate patterns that all became the hallmarks of the Art Nouveau style. Aspiring to “total works of the arts,” the practitioners of Art Nouveau used these elements to create a sense of harmony in their work. This is apparent in the works of Antoni Gaudí such as Park Güell, the design of which is perfectly integrated into the landscape, with columns seemingly sprouting from their natural surroundings.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: build on=~을 기반으로 삼다 / rely on=~에 의존하다 / return to=~로 돌아가다 / depart from=~에서 벗어나다
det.analysis:
빈칸 뒤 'Historicism, which relied heavily on copying(모방에 크게 의존한 역사주의)'이 단서예요. 아르누보는 이 모방 양식에서 '벗어나려' 생겨났어요.

① build on: 기반으로 삼다 — 오히려 계승이라 반대예요

② rely on: 의존하다 — 벗어나려는 흐름과 반대예요

③ return to: 돌아가다 — 과거로 돌아간다는 것이라 반대예요

④ depart from: ~에서 벗어나다 — 모방하던 역사주의에서 벗어나는 수단이었어요 ←정답
det.tip: emerged as a means to ______ Historicism → 벗어나다(depart from).
